name: signal-domain-one-writer-broadcasts-to-two-readers
source:
COMPONENT SigConst(out)
  PARAM k
  out.sig = k
END
COMPONENT SigGain(in, out)
  PARAM k
  out.sig = k * in.sig
END
COMPONENT SigSum(in1, in2, out)
  out.sig = in1.sig + in2.sig
END
SigConst SRC(k=2)
SigGain  A(k=3)
SigGain  B(k=5)
connect(SRC.out, A.in, B.in)
